messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] High 5xx rate on /api/generate in us-west-2 since 10:53 UTC — deploy detected at 10:51 UTC. Paging on-call: sam.

sam: on it. joining call in 2. can we get the deploy id?

deploy-bot: Deploy v2026.03.15-48 pushed to prod at 10:51:42 UTC; canary started 10:51:55; rollout to 30% completed. Image: ghcr.io/redwood/inference/model-server:2026-48-retag-latest

maia: saw a spike in error budget alerts around 10:54, matching the deploy window. Errors are primarily 502 from model-server pods failing to pull.

sam: pod events?

maia: logs from kube:
```
Warning  Failed     2s (x5 over 2m) kubelet, ip-10-0-5-12  Failed to pull image "ghcr.io/redwood/inference/model-server:2026-48-retag-latest": rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to resolve reference "ghcr.io/redwood/inference/model-server:2026-48-retag-latest": unexpected status code [manifests 2026-48-retag-latest]: 401 Unauthorized
```

jen: wtf — registry auth failing for the new tag only? other tags fine. Could be a retag propagation or GC in our mirror.

ryan: pinging eng-infra. @ryan: deploy id and CI job id?

sam: immediate mitigation: can we pause rollout / kill-switch the feature flag for the route? ops-runbook-bot, ops playbook for canary rollback?

ops-runbook-bot: Playbook: Canary rollback -> 1) Pause rollout via deploy service: `deployctl pause 2026.03.15-48` 2) Scale down new replicaset: `kubectl scale rs/model-server-2026-48 --replicas=0 -n prod` 3) Promote previous replicaset: `deployctl promote model-server@2026.03.14-12` 4) Toggle feature flag route to stable: `ffctl set route-generation stable` 5) Post incident status.

sam: doing step 1 and 2 now.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused for v2026.03.15-48 at 10:56:03 UTC.

sam: scaling down replicaset 2026-48...
```
kubectl scale rs/model-server-2026-48 --replicas=0 -n prod
```

maia: scaling completed, starting promotion of previous RS.

deploy-bot: Promotion triggered: model-server@2026.03.14-12 -> now serving 100% traffic.

sam: toggled route back to stable. `ffctl set route-generation stable` returned 200.

jen: I'm seeing error rate dropping already in ALB metrics, 502->normal in the last 2 minutes. :relieved:

incident-bot: Incident declared: INC-2026-0315-04 — customer impact: partial 502s for generation endpoints (us-west-2) 10:53–10:58 UTC. Paging ended; incident acknowledged by sam.

sam: quick root-cause triage: should we block the image tag `2026-48-retag-latest` from future deploys?

ryan: eng-infra found the mirror briefly re-signed/re-tagged some artifacts during mirror sync; GHCR returned 401 for the retag because auth token expired for that tag. Looks like CI accidentally pushed a new manifest using our CI robot creds which then got re-timestamped in the mirror.

jen: CI job 3128 shows a post-build step that does `docker tag $SHA latest && docker push ghcr...:latest` — looks like we changed retag policy in the pipeline last week. That allowed a transient tag alias to be created while registry tokens rotated.

maia: mitigation checklist: 1) Block automatic retagging in pipeline (revert pipeline change) 2) Backfill a signed, permanent tag for the image and push with service principal 3) Add registry token use audit / warn in CI 4) Improve deployment pre-check to fail if manifest fetch returns 401.

sam: assigned follow-ups: @jen take pipeline revert + MR, @ryan add registry-auth precheck in deployctl, @maia draft customer impact notes and update status page. I'll lead postmortem.

ryan: temporary rule: deployctl now rejects tags containing `-retag-` unless `--force-retag` provided and owner-approved. Pushed 11:10 UTC.

maia: status update to customers posted to status.redwood.com: "Partial errors affecting text-generation in us-west-2 from 10:53–10:58 UTC due to a bad image retag during a deploy. Traffic restored via rollback. Engineers investigating."

sam: closing on-call handoff: leaving a note for next on-call: rollback restored service, engineering leads assigned, postmortem scheduled in 48h. If anything else pops, escalate to eng-infra.

jen: adding TODO: add CI unit that validates manifest digest equality between registry and build artifact before retagging.

sam: thanks team. reactions: :thumbsup: :heart:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0315-04 status: mitigated -> monitoring.

maia: capturing logs/snippets for postmortem. will attach in follow-up thread.

sam: end thread.
